The URL highlighter now matches tildes: the `repr.url` span covers the whole `https://example.org/~user/a?b=c` string.

I made the change in `rich/highlighter.py` by adding `~` to the URL character class in the `ReprHighlighter` regex. I did not run the repo's test suite or add a test, and I didn't update the CHANGELOG. The fix was checked with one inline highlight call only.

The fix adds `~` to the URL character class in the `ReprHighlighter` regex in `rich/highlighter.py`, so tilde-containing URLs are highlighted as a single `repr.url` span; the patch is submitted (1 file changed).
